title: S2 dispatch audit v5 — production runs + human-approved retry equivalent evidence
archive_note: Structured archive of verified facts from three real production audit v5 runs (fresh-pi normal / timeout / parallel) plus the human-approved equivalent for the retry-classification branch that live production cannot directly evidence (raw SDK end/error not persisted). Extracted identifiers, states, closure evidence and hashes only; no prompt content, raw errors, tool args or outputs. Audit rows live in the local untracked .pi-astack/ directory (gitignored) and are referenced by path, not embedded in this dossier.

git.note: evidence dossier itself is uncommitted; no commit/push performed

audit_paths_note: Local untracked .pi-astack/ directory (gitignored mutable source); referenced by path, not embedded. task-row hashes below are sha256 of `jq -cS .` over the row, recomputable from this file.
